scene_payload.text: 码头海风从雾里吹来，潮湿的盐味盖过了街边的煤烟。

0.text: A salt wind rolls over the pier and cools the coal smoke.

1.text: The salt wind carries a second set of footsteps just behind yours.

2.text: The pier wind smells of tidewater and a sealed confession.

3.text: The fog breathes your name across the water before anyone speaks.
